accounting.interpretation: Reuses already evaluated frozen predictions. Panel costs describe evaluating those probes on a future checkpoint; full-table discovery is already spent and periodic training monitoring is not included.

claim_boundary: Exact discrimination of supplied finite histogram signatures and exact minimum cost within eight fixed probe blocks. Histogram equality is coarser than equality of per-input predictions and is not model equivalence. No model accuracy gain, neural dynamical quotient, statistical confidence, or external generalization theorem is claimed.
cost_unit: evaluated examples per checkpoint; reading all predicted-class counts needs no per-class model rerun

provenance.construction_note: TUNE has also served training/hyperparameter construction. The panel is a retrospective diagnostic of frozen checkpoint signatures, not an unbiased quality estimate.
provenance.observer_selection_note: The histogram language was proposed after observing the original accuracy language's blindness. This extension is exploratory and is not an independent confirmation study.
provenance.prediction_verification: Counts recomputed from retained predictions; checkpoint and metadata hashes verified. Neural inference is not rerun by this script.
provenance.probe_policy: Exactly eight fixed bins: target label modulo 8. Bins are specified before reading outcomes; correct/incorrect counts never determine bin membership.

study_role: exploratory observation-language extension after accuracy blindness
